description: This file defines a Flask route for health checks using Flask-Smorest. It creates a blueprint and a class-based view to respond with a health status message.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flask MethodView that provides a health status endpoint returning a JSON indicating service health.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to the health check endpoint, returning a JSON message indicating the service is healthy.

ctags.name: blp
ctags.pattern: /^blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", "health check", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route"/

fields.name: blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", "health check", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route"/
